an4.167:1.1: athakho āyasmā sāriputto yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahāmoggallānena saddhiṃ sammodi
an4.167:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca
an4.167:2.8: imāsaṃ āvuso catassannaṃ paṭipadānaṃ katamaṃ te paṭipadaṃ āgamma anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
an4.167:3.3: dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā
an4.167:3.5: imāsaṃ āvuso catassannaṃ paṭipadānaṃ yāyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā khippābhiññā imaṃ me paṭipadaṃ āgamma anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
